cards.subtitle: Deterministic Gotthilf Hagen (1839) & Jean Leonard Marie Poiseuille (1840) parabolic laminar pipe-flow velocity profile (v(r) = v_max*(1 - beta*(r/R)^2) where beta/2 = u/(1+u), enforcing the Navier-Stokes no-slip boundary condition at r = R so average velocity v_avg = 0.5*v_max and volumetric discharge ratio locks at Q/Q_exact = 1.0000x across all 17 wall-shear stations u in [0.0000, 1.0000] with 0/17 inflated stations) versus naive uniform plug-flow advection (v(r) = v_max across the entire cross-section, which violates wall no-slip and overestimates volumetric discharge as 1 + u to 1.2500x at u=0.25, 1.5000x at u=0.50, and 2.0000x at u=1.00 across 16/17 stations) and 64-annulus cylindrical shear ring quadrature.

cards.headline: Exact controls are useful; realism remains a separate job.
good_fit: 3D blood-vessel erythrocyte streams, lava channels, microfluidic tubes, and river canyon UV flow-map shaders
Enforcing the Navier-Stokes no-slip boundary condition v(R) = 0 so particles near walls slow down smoothly instead of scraping past stationary banks
Matching exact volumetric discharge Q = (pi * R^4 * DeltaP) / (8 * mu * L) = 0.5 * pi * R^2 * v_max
Zero-branch quadratic radial falloff 1.0 - dot(r_norm, r_norm)
not_for: High-Reynolds-number fully turbulent pipe flows where a flatter Prandtl 1/7th power-law velocity profile applies
Rigid-body conveyor belts where all points genuinely move at uniform speed
